  • Reference

    Impute missing values for numeric and categorical columns

    impute_missing.Rd

    Impute missing values (NA) in a data.frame column by column, using simple, independent strategies (no complex external dependencies).

    impute_missing(
  data,
  cols = NULL,
  exclude = NULL,
  num_method = c("median", "mean", "constant"),
  cat_method = c("mode", "constant", "new_level"),
  num_constant = 0,
  cat_constant = "Missing",
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    data

    The data.frame containing missing values.

    cols

    Optional character vector of column names to process. If NULL (default), all columns are processed.

    exclude

    Optional character vector of column names to exclude from processing.

    num_method

    Method for numeric columns: "median", "mean" or "constant".

    cat_method

    Method for character/factor columns: "mode", "constant" or "new_level".

    num_constant

    Value used if num_method = "constant" (default 0).

    cat_constant

    Value used if cat_method = "constant" (default "Missing").

    verbose

    Logical. If TRUE (default), prints a message in the console for each imputed column.

    Value

    The data.frame with missing values imputed.

    Details

    The strategy applied depends on the column type:

    • Numeric (numeric, integer):

      • "median" (default): Replace by the median (robust to outliers).

      • "mean": Replace by the mean.

      • "constant": Replace by the value supplied in num_constant (e.g. 0).

    • Categorical (character, factor):

      • "mode" (default): Replace by the most frequent value. In case of ties, alphabetical order is used.

      • "constant" or "new_level": Replace by the value cat_constant (default "Missing").

      • Note: If the column is a factor, the levels are automatically updated to include the new value if needed.

    • Logical (logical): Replace by the majority value (TRUE or FALSE).

    Examples

    df <- data.frame(
  val_num = c(10, 20, NA, 40, 100),
  val_cat = c("A", "B", NA, "A", "A"),
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
)

# Imputation: median for numeric columns, mode for factors
df_imp <- impute_missing(df)
#> impute_missing: 'val_num' (numeric) -> 1 NA imputed (median: 30)
#> impute_missing: 'val_cat' (categorical) -> 1 NA imputed (mode: A)

# Check result
print(df_imp)
#>   val_num val_cat
#> 1      10       A
#> 2      20       B
#> 3      30       A
#> 4      40       A
#> 5     100       A
